milestones.name: Jerusalem
milestones.introText: Jerusalem, city of the temple, where the church was born at Pentecost and scattered believers first carried the good news beyond its walls. From here the road west begins, following the routes the earliest missionaries walked.

milestones.name: Caesarea
milestones.introText: Caesarea Maritima, Herod's great harbor on the Mediterranean coast, where Roman ships and Roman roads meet the land of Judea. Here Peter first preached to a Gentile household, and the gospel's reach began to widen.

milestones.name: Antioch
milestones.introText: Antioch on the Orontes, third city of the empire, where believers were first called Christians. From this church missionaries were first sent out, and the road to the nations properly begins here.

milestones.name: Ephesus
milestones.introText: Ephesus, a great port city of Asia Minor and home to one of the wonders of the ancient world. Paul taught here for years, and the church that grew from his work became one of the most influential of the early centuries.

milestones.name: Rome
milestones.introText: Rome, heart of the empire, where every road on this journey has been leading. Here the good news arrives at the center of the ancient world, carried by ordinary travelers who trusted an extraordinary message.

routes.name: Coastal Route
routes.description: Three successes required. The easier road along the shoreline, testing general Bible knowledge and listening skill.

routes.name: Inland Route
routes.description: Two successes required. A moderate road through the hill country, testing Scripture knowledge and reasoning.

routes.name: Mountain Route
routes.description: One success required. The hardest road, over difficult terrain, with greater reward for the team bold enough to take it.

routes.name: By Sea to Corinth
routes.description: One success required. A sea crossing to the great trading city of Corinth.

routes.name: Overland through Macedonia
routes.description: One success required. A harder road on foot through Macedonia, retracing an earlier overland route.

communityEvents.title: The Harbor Gathering
communityEvents.description: All teams pause at Herod's harbor for a shared challenge before the roads divide. Teams answer in turn; the room succeeds together.

communityEvents.title: The Sending Church
communityEvents.description: The church at Antioch is sending out missionaries. Teams may pledge resources to equip them; generosity earns Service, and meeting the goal blesses the whole room.

communityEvents.title: The Lecture Hall
communityEvents.description: The room gathers in a hall where teaching once continued for years on end. A shared challenge, answered in turn; the room succeeds together.

communityEvents.title: The Journey's End
communityEvents.description: The first team to arrive finds the whole room gathering for a closing act of generosity, even while others are still on the road. Teams may pledge resources; meeting the goal blesses everyone still travelling.
